Lisp and symbolic computation

Recursive operations on symbolic expressions provided a foundation for Lisp.

John McCarthy

AI topics

Explore related entries. Larger tags appear on more entries.

Symbolic AITools & frameworksKnowledge representation

The contribution

McCarthy presented a formalism for symbolic expressions and their computation, including recursive functions. This gave AI researchers a language suited to manipulating programs and symbolic structures, rather than treating numerical calculation as the only computing task.

What this does not establish

Lisp development began before the paper appeared. The timeline dates the publication, not the first implementation.

Why this date?

The linked paper was published in April 1960, rather than 1958.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
